rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LUMBAR SPINE MRI / Evaluation of Neurologic Deficits (1)

criteria.description: Evaluation of low back pain with lumbosacral radiculopathy or radiating leg pain
Completion of at least 6 weeks of conservative care within the prior 6 months without meaningful improvement

required_documentation: Physical therapy records or clinical follow-up notes documenting 6 weeks of conservative treatment
rules.review_notes: Conservative care prerequisite trial for lumbar radiculopathy.

rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LUMBAR SPINE MRI / Evaluation of Neurologic Deficits / Cauda Equina Syndrome
rules.source_quote: defined symptoms (see Cauda Equina Syndrome section)

criteria.description: Clinical suspicion of acute cauda equina syndrome with saddle anesthesia, progressive bilateral motor weakness, or bowel/bladder sphincter dysfunction

required_documentation: Urgent neurological or emergency evaluation documenting saddle sensory loss or acute sphincter incontinence
rules.review_notes: Emergency cauda equina syndrome pathway bypassing conservative care trial.

rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LUMBAR SPINE MRI / EVALUATION OF KNOWN OR SUSPECTED INFECTION
rules.source_quote: EVALUATION OF KNOWN OR SUSPECTED INFECTION
rules.clinical_service_or_procedure: Lumbar Spine MRI (With and Without Contrast)

criteria.description: Suspected spinal infection (discitis, osteomyelitis, epidural abscess) with fever, elevated inflammatory markers (ESR/CRP), or recent bacteremia, OR red flags for spinal malignancy/metastasis with known cancer history

required_documentation: Clinical documentation of fever, laboratory inflammatory markers, or oncology records documenting primary malignancy
rules.review_notes: Contrast-enhanced lumbar MRI indicated immediately for spinal infection or neoplastic cord threat (conservative therapy waived).
